reviews.reason: Preserve validated package, CommonJS, packaging, and Node 24 compatibility while upstream owners still resolve older or deprecated transitives.
reviews.removalCriteria: Remove each selector once every owning dependency resolves a compatible maintained version and the applicable workspace and packaging gates pass without the override.

reviews.reason: Force vulnerable transitive versions to patched releases through the narrowest known selector instead of suppressing low-severity advisories.
reviews.removalCriteria: Remove a selector when the lockfile has no vulnerable path without it; otherwise advance the floor to the newest owner-compatible patched release and rerun the full dependency audit.

reviews.reason: Replace upstream-deprecated runtime and packaging transitives with the narrowest maintained owner-compatible releases.
reviews.removalCriteria: Remove a selector after every owner resolves a non-deprecated release without it and the dependency, desktop packaging, and applicable workspace gates remain clean.

reviews.reason: Re-review the existing undici6/7/8, fast-uri3/4, ip-address10 and DOMPurify3 floors against the October24 advisories; retain current major APIs and the existing bounded glob fixes without advisory exclusions.
reviews.removalCriteria: Remove each vulnerable-version or parent selector when every owning package resolves the patched floor without it and the full dependency audit and all applicable workspace gates pass.

reviews.reason: Remove got and its unpatched cache dependency from app-builder-lib using the maintained fetch downloader, paired with the compatibility patch that preserves request deadlines, environment proxies, progress and checksum validation under Node 24. Forge 8 independently removes got and fast-glob.
reviews.removalCriteria: Remove this selector and the compatibility patch when app-builder-lib owns @electron/get 5 or later with fetch-compatible deadlines and proxy handling and the downloader plus packaging gates pass without them.

reviews.reason: Patch source-map-js 1.2.1 (GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q, indexed source-map section offsets, reachable through sanitize-html>postcss) to its first patched release on the same major line. The http-cache-semantics floor carried on the base branch is not needed here: this graph no longer contains got, cacheable-request or http-cache-semantics.
reviews.removalCriteria: Remove this selector once postcss and @tailwindcss/node resolve the patched floor without it and the full dependency audit plus all applicable workspace gates pass.

reviews.reason: Patch fast-jwt 6.3.2 (GHSA-x937-hj6v-793p, the verifier cache accepting expired tokens that carry no iat, runtime-reachable through @fastify/jwt in the server and the desktop-embedded server) to its first patched release on the same major line, inside the range @fastify/jwt already accepts.
reviews.removalCriteria: Remove this selector once @fastify/jwt resolves fast-jwt 6.3.4 or later without it and the full dependency audit plus the server and desktop gates pass.

reviews.reason: Close the remaining October advisories on the existing undici 7/8, fast-uri 3/4 and ip-address 10 lines. Owner-specific and vulnerable-version selectors retain current major APIs; no advisory is suppressed. Also repair the older Zod peer copy retained by browser AI SDK packages. Keep Puppeteer on major 25 through its owning Lighthouse range, so Chromium BiDi uses its upstream Zod4 migration instead of overriding a Zod3 consumer across majors. Patch the recursive iframe fallback regression introduced by the existing sanitize-html2.18.0 PR through a same-line vulnerable-version selector.
reviews.removalCriteria: Remove each selector once all owning dependencies resolve a patched version without it and the complete dependency audit and applicable workspace gates pass.
